three.js r160 / npm version 0.160.0 (MIT)
Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r160
Files: build/three.module.js; examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js;
examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js; examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js.
LICENSE is preserved in three/LICENSE.
Module import paths were rewritten to sibling local files; one upstream
indentation whitespace was normalized. Runtime behavior is unchanged.
No CDN or external decoder is used. Draco / Meshopt / KTX2 compressed assets require
additional decoders and are not supported by this minimal offline viewer.
